motion.name: name-entrance
motion.purpose: 14 exported effects use actual Chakra Petch contours: eight-piece S explosion, point-grown W edges, preserved nine-tile e and decoded i, water, print, dots, sand, radar, binary, graph, integral, search, and raster.

motion.name: letter-stagger
motion.purpose: Per-letter starts for the selected effect map.

motion.name: typed-supporting-text
motion.purpose: Only Home credentials and four-sentence summary type after850ms and2300ms. Four route buttons and header/navigation/footer stay static. Text keeps stable layout and accessible full strings, with reduced-motion immediate text. Last-character animation completion sets type-complete and disables subsequent animation restarts on cached-page visibility changes.

motion.name: shape-phase
motion.purpose: Five-body cap and existing stagger unchanged. Each spawn selects shuffled order[0], forms once, and retains its solid until fracture or exit. Anchors are nearest unused actual visible gridNodes members (fade>.35, projected at least12px inside viewport), stored by idX/idZ/plane and reconstructed by gridNodePosition. No synthetic candidate grid. True edges draw as staggered partial segments; tethers remain visible throughout construction at alpha .24 × birth fade and are removed only at complete assembly. Shared gridNodes use viewport-adaptive horizontal extent, minimum radius6, with vertical connectors across every adjacent plane at idX%3/idZ%2. Offscreen same-side line endpoints are culled.

motion.name: pointer-smoothing
motion.purpose: Rigid cursor impulses and spin, damped flight, and mass-weighted approximate spherical collision impulses. Body mass equals size cubed; small sizes .18–.26, medium bodies .62. Construction anchors are distinct grid intersections independent of final size. Collision/wall stress drives breakup without vertex deformation. Grid stays pointer-independent.

motion.name: motion-accessibility
motion.purpose: Disable CSS animation/transitions and settle the canvas; hidden tabs stop rendering.

motion.name: volume-travel
motion.purpose: Randomized rates without timed lifetime reset; full right exit or stress >= 1.4 schedules an independent left replacement after 1.5–4s. No companion waves. One fragment per vertex spins, receives cursor/body impulses, and fades over 7s; cap 60. Left/top/bottom bounce, right open; continuous grid identities and stable per-spawn anchors.

motion.name: home-magnetic-button
motion.purpose: MagneticActions owns one passive window pointer-move listener; only the nearest fixed rectangle within 44px gets attraction with squared falloff, while others reset. Caps remain 7px/5px and 5deg/7deg. Pre-hover attraction does not fill. Hover/focus/press activates 30 blocks in 10 columns and 3 rows with 24ms column/16ms row offsets, max 248ms. Press adds 4px down, -10px depth, scale .975 and 70ms response. Touch/Enter states reset on release/cancel/leave/blur. Reduced motion disables transforms and makes fill instant.

motion.name: name-letter-replay
motion.purpose: Mouse entry or touch tap rekeys only the selected original letter effect at zero delay. Reduced motion disables replay. Readiness initializes only if its array is empty, so cached-page Activity visibility does not restart the introduction guard. Per-letter completion disables decorative animation after its terminal event (last raster/search piece, last binary column, or solid glyph), keeping the glyph visible across Activity changes. Intentional replay clears only that completion and rekeys the letter.

motion.name: summary-word-hover
motion.purpose: Summary words brighten to foreground; reduced motion omits the transform.

motion.name: page-door
motion.value: Concurrent exit440ms / enter600ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.3,1); no delay
motion.purpose: Stable page-content ViewTransition update/enter/exit door preserves cached children. Left45% pivot,160vw perspective. Old snapshot z2 rotates-58deg/translate3d20vw,0,6vw,opacity1→.55 at65%→0. New snapshot z1 starts opacity.35/rotate58deg/translate3d-4vw,0,-50vw,opacity.7 at45%,thenlandsopacity1. Header/canvas remain outside; root snapshot disabled; reduced motion disables animations and unsupported browsers navigate normally. Snapshots ignore pointer events; active-transition page-stage is inert while the persistent header remains clickable. Browser inspection confirmed distinct depths during navigation; full checks and build passed.

narrative.northStar: Open content over a tactical graph
narrative.overview:
The approved open-layout-v6 direction places clear, warm typography over a quiet technical background. Foreground content is unboxed, left aligned, and spacious. Soft charcoal and dusty red temper the angular geometry; the professional portfolio leads the site’s identity.

Movement belongs to the spatial field and the name’s first entrance. A shared world-space projection carries a five-plane lattice and a restrained mix of large and small angular bodies from back left toward front right, advancing rightward and nearer the camera. Shape nodes begin at snapped lattice intersections, assemble once into rotating forms with anchor tethers, then keep their selected shape until fracture or right-edge exit. Bright beacons pulse at intersections. The lattice projection stays independent of the pointer. Forms receive rigid cursor impulses and spin, followed by damped flight. Only body and wall collisions accumulate stress; readable foreground content stays stable. Decorative content icons are excluded, while functional header controls and GitHub, LinkedIn, and email icons remain.
keyCharacteristics: Soft charcoal, dusty red, and warm gray.
Angular background depth with restrained pointer response.
Individual letter entrances that settle into readable text.
Functional navigation and truthful, intentionally blank media placeholders.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Use the existing dusty red family for interaction and geometry; do not introduce a second competing accent.

rules.name: The Readable Finish Rule
rules.body: Entrance animation must resolve to stable, unobscured text; the full name remains available to assistive technology throughout.

rules.name: The Background Geometry Rule
rules.body: Keep tactical lines and grids behind the content. Foreground sections remain open and unboxed.

dos: Do keep text and navigation readable and stable above the reactive background.
Do use Chakra Petch for the homepage name, Manrope for supporting type, and the existing charcoal/red palette across routes.
Do preserve keyboard focus, expanded control states, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep unsupplied media visibly identified as placeholders.
Do place each navigation destination on its own page and keep Home as the introduction.
donts: Don't add decorative content icons; retain icons that serve header links or controls.
Don't turn open foreground content into tactical panels, tables, or bordered cards.
Don't substitute stark black/crimson contrast or flowing ribbon geometry for the chosen direction.
Don't invent photographs, project screenshots, forms, or component variants absent from the implementation.
